rubrics.text: on waking and turning in bed
extending over the soles to the toes
left one burning while the other is cold
resting feet on floor while sitting
from putting arm out of bed
the arm in front of him
as if tendons were too short
alternating with pain in right temple
lying on back with leg flexed
leaves lower and goes to upper limbs
turn over on the well side before he can rise from bed
in places least covered by flesh
putting the arm behind him agg.
extending into arm on moving it
in the one on which he lies
extending into fourth and fifth fingers hanging arm down
to larynx and back to hand
on moving right arm toward left
moving it back and forth amel.
moving head from side to side
alternating with stitches in great toe
bringing thumb and index finger together
as if they would be torn
if flesh would be torn from bone
when lying right limb across the leg
hanging over side of bed amel.
when putting feet out of bed amel.
alternating with tearing pain in hip
alternating with the same in hand
extending to tips of both outer fingers
alternating with convulsive pain in arms
down thigh during effort to urinate
as if tendon would snap on stepping
